title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 11B: Abilities
subtitle: can / can’t, abilities and (very / quite) well from 11B

words.def: to move through water using your arms and legs
words.sent: I can ___ — I go to the pool every week.

words.def: to make food hot and ready to eat
words.sent: My dad can ___ very well — his pho is great.

words.def: to make a picture with colours and a brush
words.sent: She can ___ beautiful pictures of flowers.

words.def: to make music with your voice
words.sent: He can ___ very well — he’s in a band.

words.def: to move your body to music
words.sent: Can you ___? — Yes, I go to salsa classes.

words.def: to make a car go and control it
words.sent: She can ___ — she drives to work.

words.def: to play a team sport where you hit a ball over a high net
words.sent: We ___ on the beach in summer.

words.def: to play games with 52 small pictures (the king, the queen …)
words.sent: My grandparents ___ every evening.

words.def: to sit on a horse and make it go
words.sent: On the farm, the children can ___.

words.def: to sit on a bike and make it go
words.sent: I can ___ — I go to school on my bike.

words.def: to move very fast on your legs
words.sent: He can ___ 10 kilometres in an hour.

words.def: really good at doing it (✓✓✓)
words.sent: She can swim ___ — she wins every race.

words.def: OK, not very good, not bad (✓)
words.sent: I can cook ___ — my food is OK.

words.def: zero; not even a little (✗)
words.sent: I can’t sing ___ — it’s terrible!

words.def: in a good way
words.sent: She can drive ___. She’s a careful driver.

words.def: used to say you are able to do something
words.sent: I ___ ride a bike, but I can’t drive.

words.def: cannot; not able
words.sent: I ___ swim — I don’t like water.

words.def: a question about what someone is able to do
words.sent: ___ ride a horse? — No, I can’t.

words.def: a short yes answer to Can you …?
words.sent: Can you swim? — ___. I swim every day.

words.def: a short no answer to Can you …?
words.sent: Can you drive? — ___. I don’t have a car.
